See the three packages

A car workshop at Premier @ Kaki Bukit that explains before it charges

JT Autoworks is a diagnose-first car workshop in Kaki Bukit, at unit #02-52 of Premier @ Kaki Bukit. We focus on BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi and other European cars and on EVs, and every make is welcome. Quotes come with no obligation and no charge, and parts are replaced only when necessary.

Waiting? There is a lounge with complimentary drinks.

How a job runs here

Diagnosis comes before parts.

  1. WhatsApp us

    Tell us the car and what it is doing. A short video helps.

  2. Inspect and diagnose

    We find the root cause before we talk about parts.

  3. Quote, no charge

    You get a quote with no obligation and no charge.

  4. Repair only what is needed

    Parts are replaced only when they really need replacing.

  5. Collect your car

    We walk you through what was done.

Questions people ask

What are your opening hours?

Monday to Friday 9:00am to 5:00pm, Saturday 9:00am to 3:00pm. Closed on Sunday.

Where exactly is the workshop?

Unit #02-52, Premier @ Kaki Bukit, 8 Kaki Bukit Ave 4, Singapore 415875. Come in through Gate 1.

Do you charge for a quote?

No. Quotes come with no obligation and no charge.

What do the service packages include?

Each package covers 3 services with engine oil, an oil filter, a 50-point check and a coolant top-up every time, plus aircon flushing and gas top-up, tyre rotation and tyre patching once.

Do you work on EVs?

Yes. EV-trained technicians handle EV diagnostics and servicing, and towing can be arranged for EVs.

Which car makes do you service?

Our focus is BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Volkswagen, Porsche, Lexus, Land Rover and Volvo. All makes are welcome.
